name: Hierarchical LOD for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A tree-based hierarchy for 3DGS primitives that enables real-time rendering of large scenes by providing Level-of-Detail (LOD) solutions. It consists of interior and leaf nodes, where every node is associated with a 3D Gaussian (either a leaf from original optimization or a merged interior node).
summary: Hierarchical LOD for 3D Gaussian Splatting constructs a tree of merged Gaussian primitives to enable real-time large-scale rendering by swapping high-resolution leaves for lower-resolution interior nodes based on screen-space granularity.
